systems.platform: an electronic Annual School Census template developed by NEMIS; the network said to be moving from stand-alone to networked computers
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Education (Statistics and NEMIS, under Educational Planning, Research and Development), with State Ministries of Education, SUBEBs and Local Government Education Authorities
systems.tiers: data originates at the school and passes to the LGA, the state and the federal database; over 900 data nodes; the electronic census template deployed to states and then to schools

systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Education; states monitor and supervise its conduct
systems.tiers: school heads trained to complete it electronically

prescribed by the guidelines: teachers in pre-primary, basic and senior secondary schools to record daily events, including learner bio-data and academic performance, the head teacher to report to the LGEA, weekly as recommended, and the LGEA to store reports in a database, preferably electronic

note: The 2021 policy describes NEMIS in operation as the Annual School Census and the flow of school returns upward, says the present system attends to enrolments and a few other events, and itself remarks that the census is often taken to be the EMIS; per-learner record keeping and weekly reporting are what it prescribes, not what it states is done, so there is no fact.
